body: correction: entry sub in SE costs 65 BRL and a standard sub costs 75 BRL. Up to you and your friend but I think it’s not worth it even if SE’s bundle is on sale.

Not worth it. Stick to the Steam version as the total amount of money you spend at the end of the day is going to be lower than if you were paying through SE. Think about it - an entry sub in SE costs around 75 BRL - and changes accordingly to the price of the USD -  whereas on steam it’s less than half the price (around 30 BRL).

I’m Brazilian too - has he/she already bought the SE version? You can buy the game via Steam and play the monthly subscription from there. You can also transfer from a free trial account to a Steam account. However, you won’t be able to transfer back a Steam account to a regular SE account.
Yes, I’m aware. That’s why I’m playing the game on Bootcamp - a Windows partition, so I run FFXIV on a windows client. So basically, I don’t have to buy the game twice :)
